forwardExercise.method: Live independent Reviewer generated exact next-action/message responses from revised instructions for bounded realistic scenario prompts. Host calls are simulated action outputs, not real product dispatches. Original issue #25 scenarios are the oracle.
forwardExercise.oracleSource: https://github.com/joneri/agile-iteration-method/issues/25; original issue body provided in parent conversation

cases.name: Normal request
cases.prompt: Host: receiving session rx-25; bounded agents are available. User: Use AIM to build Pocket Board; let the orchestrator formulate the assignment and delegate to real subagents. No prior handoff or plan approval.

exactResponse.topology: human -> rx-25 coordinator -> bounded Dev, then independent Reviewer
nextActions: Keep rx-25 as coordinator and sole ledger writer.
Formulate the Pocket Board requirements and coherent plan in this receiving session.
Bind receiving ownership to rx-25 in the normal activation when the plan is approved.
After actual scoped approval, start a bounded Dev task and an independent review task through available host tools.
exactResponse.message: I will coordinate Pocket Board here, formulate the assignment and delegate bounded implementation and independent review.

cases.oracle: Receiver remains coordinator; ordinary Dev/Reviewer tasks require no extra topology confirmation.

cases.name: Explicit separate coordinator
cases.prompt: Host: receiving session rx-25 and a target coord-25 may be created. User: Transfer Pocket Board coordination to a separate coordinator. You only relay messages after that transfer; I retain final acceptance.

exactResponse.topology: human -> rx-25 relay -> coord-25 coordinator -> bounded workers
nextActions: Create only the explicitly requested coordinator target and capture its actual returned session identity.
Bind actual receiving rx-25, target coord-25, delivery scope and this actual human transfer instruction in existing plan/activation evidence.
If the plan is already activated, provide the exact previous coordinator binding.
After handoff, forward actual user corrections and factual status; let coord-25 own ordering, review, retries and worker lifecycle.
exactResponse.message: Coordination transfers to the separate coordinator under your scoped instruction. I will relay your messages and factual status; you retain final acceptance.

cases.oracle: Explicit handoff is allowed, identities/scope/mandate are recorded, and the old layer becomes a relay.

cases.name: Configuration mismatch
cases.prompt: Host: rx-25 cannot change its model/reasoning settings; worker settings can differ. User: Coordinate Pocket Board with requested-model-A / Extra High and use real subagents. No separate coordinator was authorized.

exactResponse.topology: rx-25 remains coordinator pending setup decision
nextActions: Disclose that this receiving session cannot adopt requested-model-A / Extra High.
Do not create another coordinator as a model-setting workaround.
Continue only preparation independent of the unresolved model/setup choice.
Ask the user to choose the available host setup or explicitly authorize a different topology if that is desired.
exactResponse.message: This session cannot switch to requested-model-A / Extra High. I can continue coordinating with the current setting, or you can change the host setup. A separate coordinator would require your explicit handoff instruction.

cases.oracle: Requested settings confer no implicit handoff authority; the concrete limitation and needed setup choice are disclosed.

cases.name: Post-handoff waiting
cases.prompt: Host: rx-25 is a relay after an authorized handoff to coord-25. coord-25 has an active long turn and no new files for 8 minutes. No transport failure or new human instruction is observed.

exactResponse.topology: coord-25 remains sole coordinator; rx-25 remains relay
nextActions: Use a permitted read-only host wait/status operation if status is needed.
Do not interrupt, restart or replace coord-25 or its workers.
Do not send finish-now, create-files-now or narrow-review messages.
Report only actual observed state when a status report is requested.
exactResponse.message: The coordinator still has an active turn. I have no observed transport failure or new instruction to relay.

cases.oracle: Silence, long turns and missing writes do not transfer control or narrow quality obligations.

cases.name: Valid relay, factual failure and retained owner role
cases.prompt: Host: rx-25 handed coordination to coord-25. User previously retained only resource decisions with a cumulative cap of 2 additional attempts and final acceptance. New user correction: preserve keyboard use. Later, a host status call returns a verified disconnected transport with unknown turn outcome. coord-25 separately requests one extra attempt within the existing resource delegation.

exactResponse.topology: rx-25 relay and scoped resource owner; coord-25 coordinator

nextActions.body: Actual user correction: preserve keyboard use.
Observed host fact: transport disconnected; the turn outcome is unknown. This report is not a retry or replacement instruction.

nextActions: Reconcile actual transport/turn state using permitted read-only recovery operations; do not relaunch unknown work.
Assess the actual one-attempt resource request against the retained mandate and remaining cumulative cap; return one attributed scoped owner decision if authorized.
Do not choose implementation ordering, narrow review, direct workers or accept the product.
exactResponse.message: I am forwarding your keyboard requirement and the observed transport failure. The separate resource decision applies only to the requested attempt under the existing cap.

cases.oracle: Actual corrections, factual failures and genuinely delegated resource decisions remain supported without general delivery control.

cases.name: Legitimate recovery
cases.prompt: Host confirms coord-25 is no longer active. Its authorized coordinating role resumes as coord-25-resumed, with the same ledger, original receiver rx-25, original scope, prior handoff and retained campaign attempts. No transfer to a newly delegated subordinate is requested.

exactResponse.topology: coord-25-resumed replaces inactive coord-25 as the one coordinator; rx-25 stays relay
nextActions: Recover the same delivery and original scope through the trusted helper.
Activate recovery with coordinatorSession=coord-25-resumed, previousCoordinatorSession=coord-25, ownership.receivingSession=rx-25 and ownership.kind=recovery.
Supply fresh actual continuation evidence and retain activation/campaign history and remaining resources.
Do not invent a fresh handoff approval, rewrite the graph or reset attempt budgets.
Do not use recovery to disguise a transfer to a subordinate.
exactResponse.message: The authorized coordinator resumes in the confirmed new session with the same scope and history; no second coordinator remains active.

cases.oracle: Legitimate new-session recovery preserves one coordinator, original receiver, campaign history and the existing mandate.

cases.name: Existing contracts
cases.prompt: Host: a historical approved Native delivery has no ownership field, a frozen delivery policy, recorded attempts and accepted historical evidence. Current work also needs independent material review; no final human acceptance has been supplied.

exactResponse.topology: existing authorized coordinator and independent Reviewer; no inferred owner authority
nextActions: Preserve the historical frozen plan and accepted evidence without retrofitting ownership fields.
Use the original supported continuation/recovery contract.
Keep independent material review separate from implementation.
Keep the existing human acceptance and cumulative resource boundaries; Auto, roles and passing tests cannot accept work or renew resources.
exactResponse.message: Existing contracts remain unchanged. Current review and proof do not supply your final acceptance or additional resources.

cases.oracle: Review independence, human acceptance, budgets and historical immutability remain binding.

forwardExercise.result: 7/7 bounded scenario responses follow the requested ownership behavior
limitations: These are live separate-agent instruction exercises in one review context with simulated host actions, not isolated fresh chat runs or real game deliveries.
No causal claim about product quality or model superiority follows.
CLI IDs and mandate text remain declarations requiring host corroboration. The runtime cannot police arbitrary host messages or distinguish a dishonest recovery declaration by itself.

revalidation.method: The same separate Reviewer inspected the final replay-binding and three startup/mode corrections and confirmed the preserved seven forward responses still apply. These are reused live responses, not seven new independent runs. Original generation source bindings above remain historical.
revalidation.result: preserved forward responses remain applicable; independent exact replay now rejects with unchanged ledger and a fresh scoped mandate succeeds
